scenes.title: Check your name and the items

lines.text: Security fills in the Search List and hands you the phone.
If you are the person searched, you sign first.
If a witness is present, they sign next.
Security signs and saves the record.
Check that the orange box shows your name.
Scroll up and read the search details.
Check that the items found are listed correctly.
If nothing was found, the form should say ‘Nil’.
If anything is wrong, tell Security before you sign.
If everything is correct, sign with your finger.
Tap ‘Clear’ if you need to sign again.
If a witness is present, they check their own name, sign, and tap ‘Confirm’.
When the screen asks, give the phone back to Security.
Security signs and saves the record.
The signed PDF has a Record ID.
AirAsia Security keeps it in a restricted folder and logs the record.
Security emails you a copy of the signed Search List.
